title: Contents Packout & Storage — Number of Jobs a Customer May Hold
content:
**A customer may hold any number of contents jobs at once, one for each loss address; landlords and property managers with furnished units or common-area furnishings and commercial owners with several sites routinely hold more than one. Each job carries its own inventory, storage, ledger and invoice.**

This rule applies to every Contents Packout & Storage tier. There is no maximum number of contents jobs per customer.

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a ceiling on how many contents jobs one customer holds? | No; there is no maximum per customer. |
| What separates one job from another? | The loss address: one job for each loss address. |
| Do two jobs of one customer share an inventory, storage, ledger or invoice? | No; each job carries its own. |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A property manager with furnished units at three different addresses may hold three contents jobs at once, one for each address, each with its own inventory, storage, ledger and invoice.
